pr_title: Fix 'openssl req' to be able to use provided keytypes
pr_body:
'openssl req' was still using old APIs that could only deal with
EVP_PKEY_ASN1_METHOD based EVP_PKEYs.  Now modified to use more
generic functions that can handle all forms of EVP_PKEY, this app
should be ready for the future.

Fixes #15388

issue_context.title: req command doesn't work with providers
issue_context.body: ....therefore if your implementation is in a provider, it won't be found.  I believe I was told in a past PR that `EVP_PKEY_asn1_find_str()` was to be deprecated.
comments: There is a fairly simple work.around which is to generate a private key file first with `genpkey`. And then use that file as the parameter to `-key` instead of using `-newkey`
.......req calls EVP_PKEY_asn1_find_str() with the algorithm string. It does not consider providers.
Good catch.  It's not very hard to adapt it, PR coming up!
Refactoring is in #15400, currently in draft
@levitte , should I mark this as closed or will you?
@anhu, it will happen automatically when #15400 is merged, since the commit there has "Fixes #15388" in it
